literal_meaning: পরস্পর আঘাত বা হানা (mutual strikes or attacks)
figurative_meaning_bn: দুটি বিরুদ্ধ পক্ষের পরস্পর যুদ্ধ বা আক্রমণ
figurative_meaning_en: Mutual war or attack between two opposing parties
example_sentences_in_english: There's a clash going on between the two groups.
Mutual attacks have started in the political rivalry.
note: This idiom is commonly used in contexts of rivalry and is a staple in everyday Bengali conversation.
